name: settings-dev-mode-dark
html:
PREFERENCES

Game settings

100%

Every sound of the game. 0% is silent.

100%

Adjust regional and battle music. 0% is silent.

Current theme: none playing

60%

Buttons, windows and the game's events. 0% is silent.

Zoom

100%

Ctrl+Plus or Ctrl+= zooms in, Ctrl+- zooms out, Ctrl+0 is the actual size.

F11 switches it too.

Unlocks editing the attributes, bonuses and money, the EXP form, restoring HP and Mana, adding spells and items from the catalogues, the combat test, levelling without EXP and any race. The same for every character.

Mods

The .pak files in the mods folder, in the order they load. Switching one on or off takes effect when the game is next started.

No mods. A mod is a .pak file in the mods folder of the game folder (Menu › Open game folder).
